title: Links from the lab and the bake script
author: claude
summary: The lab can log a snapshot, and every bake adds its own entry.
what: The lab got a 'log snapshot' button and a 'Dev log' link, and the bake script now adds an entry when a bake succeeds.
why: The most useful moments to record are the ones when something has just been made.
how:
- The snapshot button saves the canvas as a picture, asks for a title and note, and keeps the camera, mood and slider values as settings. Both only exist in the dev build.
- The bake script writes a preview picture of the probe (`out/probe_<mood>_preview.jpg`) and adds a "Bake: <mood>, <samples> samples" entry.
